methodology: forced GC + Runtime used-heap diff, 3 trials, median; per-request allocation = ThreadMXBean allocated bytes over 50 requests after 300 warm-up requests; estimates, not supported capacity
perPlayerRetained: nothing: the reconstructor is stateless; requests and results are values the caller owns and drops (frontier continuation keeps only the exact-witness states of the last result)
bounds: 256 live nodes, 256 materialized histories per node, 64 reported candidates, 32 coverage reasons, 16 notes, 4096 envelope cells per scan (ReconstructionRequest.SearchBudget.DEFAULT)
